title: Stadia was some of the most fun I’ve had gaming, but it was right to disappear
summary: The early phases of Stadia felt like a beta until more games and more functions were added. Yes, the gaming landscape has become a very different place, some seven years on from the GDC announcement of Google’s cloud gaming system.
